title: Replace kbs_init/kbs_insert/kbs_destroy with pure Rust BitSet
description: Replace the 3 kbitset FFI functions (kbs_init, kbs_insert, kbs_destroy) with a pure Rust implementation using either the bit_set crate or a simple Vec<u64> wrapper. These are trivial inline functions (~2 lines each) used only by bcf_trim_alleles/bcf_remove_allele_set in src/bcf/record.rs. Complexity: trivial. Unlocks: bcf_trim_alleles path.
